item.title: NSF Leadership in a New Era of Science
item.description: Founded in 1950, the U.S. National Science Foundation was created to keep American discovery at the forefront. That mission remains unchanged.

item.title: Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Rich in Methanol
item.description: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS holds unusually high amounts of methanol, indicating it formed under conditions quite different from those that shape typical comets.
